submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv found cool_rate as the only candidate with a nominally significant association with tensile_mpa after adjusting for lab (coef≈+0.29, p≈0.026); all other candidates were non-significant (p>0.25), and humidity's raw correlation was confounded by site. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ cool_rate + lab indicators) gave estimate 0.089, SE 0.131, p=0.499, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. The exploratory signal did not replicate, so no direct effect is confirmed.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
d = df.dropna(subset=['tensile_mpa']).copy()
labd = pd.get_dummies(d['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
for c in cands:
    sub = d.dropna(subset=[c])
    X = pd.concat([sub[[c]].astype(float), labd.loc[sub.index]], axis=1)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(sub['tensile_mpa'], X).fit()
    print(f"{c:14s} coef={m.params[c]:+.4f} p={m.pvalues[c]:.4f} n={len(sub)}")

print("DONE_NUMPY")

    sub = d.dropna(subset=[c])
    y = sub['tensile_mpa'].values
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(sub)), sub[c].values, labd.loc[sub.index].values])
    beta,*_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)
    resid = y - X@beta
    n,k = X.shape
    s2 = resid@resid/(n-k)
    cov = s2*np.linalg.inv(X.T@X)
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
    t = beta[1]/se[1]
    p = 2*(1-stats.t.cdf(abs(t), n-k))
    print(f"PER {c:14s} coef={beta[1]:+.4f} p={p:.4f} n={n}")
print("DONE_PER")
